title: A checker of the comparison
description: What the runner needs to know about the checker whose adapter lives in the folder of this file.

label.description: The checker's name in a report. Folders with the same label are variants of one checker.

variant.description: What tells this folder from another one with the same label, such as the language of the package the checker is used through.

version.description: The version the folder pins, as the report states it.

dialect.description: The dialect the checker reads. Every schema is rewritten to it before the checker is asked.

build.description: The command that builds the adapter. It is run once, in the folder.

run.description: The command that starts the adapter, in the folder.
